text: My main symptom is Mildly pruritic rash on trunk and extremities. I also have Low-grade fever, Rhinorrhea, Headache, Facial rash not involving the perioral skin. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scarlet Fever. The combination of recent viral-like symptoms (fever, headache, rhinorrhea), a rash starting on the trunk/extremities, and a characteristic facial rash sparing the perioral area is classic for this condition. Please ensure the patient has not been given aspirin.
